title: timeline_{scenario}.json
description: Traverse timeline (F9): [{t_min, event, station, o2_left_L, t_home_min, margin_min}]. v1.1.0: optional margin_binding, in_partner_line, o2_tasks_left_L, o2_margin_min_planning_rate (WS2 pipeline/engine/traverse.py); events include turn_back. v1.1.1: optional access_dist_m on station rows. v1.1.3: margin_binding may be "EVA duration" (D28).

event.description: depart | arrive | leave | return | turn_back | o2_checkpoint (WS2); other strings allowed

margin_binding.description: the term that sets margin_min (as cards/{station}.json)

in_partner_line.description: station rows only: station inside the partner line

o2_tasks_left_L.description: O2 still needed for station tasks, L

o2_margin_min_planning_rate.description: O2 margin at the planning O2 rate, min

access_dist_m.description: station rows only: walk-in from the access cell to the science point, m (not modelled) (v1.1.1)
